synopsis: TruckSim and CarSim are commercial, road-heritage dynamics tools owned by Applied Intuition through its March 2022 acquisition of Mechanical Simulation [f9128, f15971, f8402]. The tools appear among the booklet’s vehicle and machine dynamics, terrain and soil offerings, but their current off-road depth was not verified [f8356, f8586]. A 2022 press release claimed expansion into off-road, agricultural, construction, mining and military applications; this is reported expansion evidence, not verified current capability [f8585, f15972, f9129, f8586]. Simulink and other unspecified interfaces are reported, while sensor capabilities are listed as not applicable [f9131, f9130]. No public price or latest release was found, leaving procurement and version-selection gaps [f9132, f9133].
